column3: NASB reads “Jesus Christ” in the order of other manuscripts; the critical text has “Christ Jesus.” “A called apostle” is rendered “called as an apostle,” and it adds “our.”
NASB follows the critical text; “called holy” is rendered “saints by calling,” and it adds “Lord” and reorders the verse. A full-width colon appears in the NASB text.
